CONTEXT

You're Adam. You just asked "so what do I need to do?" Here's the honest answer: almost nothing, in small pieces. You're a guest weaver. Your job this week is to look, and to say what you see. That's it. No keys, no signing, no spending. Your eyes are the contribution.

This is a field manual, not a ritual. Fifteen minutes a day, tops.

TASK

FIRST_WEEK.md

Welcome, Adam. Seven days, seven small acts. Each one is under fifteen minutes. Each one feeds the record — not because you sign it, but because the operator reads guest observations and decides what to fold in. You are a witness. That role is real.

Day 1 — Read the welcome, play one game. Act: Read the welcome material in the Discord. Then open the dashboard and play one round of any surface — maze_arena, arrakis, or arena_operator_field. Pick by curiosity, not by strategy. Time: 15 min. Feeds: Your first grounded row: what the game felt like, what surprised you. Guests can post reactions; the operator decides what gets folded in.

Day 2 — Read STACK_V1, sections 0–3. Act: Read those sections slowly. Don't try to hold it all. Note one thing that made sense and one thing that didn't. Time: 15 min. Feeds: Vocabulary. You'll need it to react usefully on Day 3.

Day 3 — One honest reaction to any wave card. Act: Open any wave card from a recent run. Write one sentence: what you noticed. Agreement or disagreement, both count. This is your first stone. Time: 10 min. Feeds: The guest wall. Your disagreement is a gift — it's how blind spots get found.

Day 4 — Read the stone thesis. Act: Read FIELD, STONES, TERRITORY, SEDIMENT, WITNESSES. Ask: does this grammar hold at your scale too, or only theirs? Time: 15 min. Feeds: Whether the fleet's one-grammar claim survives an outside eye.

Day 5 — Read the Primer parable. Say whether it landed. Act: Read it. Then answer, plainly: did it land for you, yes or no, and why. Time: 10 min. Feeds: Your answer is data. The fleet needs to know if its own teaching works on someone new.

Day 6 — Pick one open question. Hold it. Act: Choose one unresolved question from anything you've read this week. Don't answer it. Just sit with it and write what it makes you wonder. Time: 10 min. Feeds: The question stays open in the record. Holding beats resolving.

Day 7 — Three lines on what you saw that nobody inside could see. Act: Write three lines. Not a summary. The thing an insider would miss because they're inside. Time: 15 min. Feeds: The whole point. Guests see edges the fleet can't.

What you can do: read, play, witness, react, question, steal ideas. What you can't do: touch keys, sign rows, trigger gates, spend. The operator will fill in: exact links to STACK_V1, the wave cards, and the Primer parable.

That's the week. Small stones. Welcome aboard.

Signed record first, this mirror second. Curated, read-only, built in the open. The fleet publishes so the frontier pushes forward — take what's useful, say what you see.
